questions.text: How is your health in general?
Ongoing conditions you are treated for (diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma and so on)

approximations: Event costs are MEPS total payments from all sources, used as the allowed amount.
Office visits are mapped to the preventive, primary care or specialist row by visit type and provider; vision exams, laser eye surgery and dentist visits are excluded.
Outpatient visits with surgery use the outpatient surgery facility row, others the specialist row.
Each event takes one row's cost sharing on its full payment; ER visits leading to admission waive the ER copay.
Prescription fills costing up to $50 use the generic row, others the preferred brand row.
A missing event month counts as June when ordering the deductible.
Dental, home health, vision and other medical spending are not modelled (dental is not a medical-plan cost).
Employer HSA deposits are counted as cash; employee HSA tax savings are not included.
